mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS student_id, s.name, s.email, s.github_url, s.desired_job, s.preferred_region, s.military_status, s.completed_on, s.skills, c.id AS course_id, c.name AS course_name, c.cohort, c.campus, c.started_on, c.ended_on, cl.content AS cover_letter_content, cl.updated_at AS cover_letter_updated_at, cp.extracted_at AS profile_updated_at, cp.profile AS competency_profile FROM student s JOIN course c ON c.id = s.course_id LEFT JOIN student_cover_letter cl ON cl.student_id = s.id LEFT JOIN competency_profile cp ON cp.student_id = s.id WHERE s.id = #{studentId}
SELECT id AS item_id, source, school_name, major, degree, status, graduated_on FROM student_education WHERE student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id AS item_id, source, company_name, position, started_on, ended_on, description FROM student_career WHERE student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id AS item_id, source, name, issuer, acquired_on FROM student_certificate WHERE student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id AS item_id, title, period_text, team_size, tech_stack, portfolio_file_url AS portfolio_file_name, include_in_apply FROM student_project WHERE student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY id
